**q25.** Engine: a CEL-based filter engine in `internal/filter` (internal/filter/engine.go:13,23 `Engine`/`NewEngine`). Mechanism: the filter string is compiled by the CEL-derived parser into a dialect-agnostic condition tree (`ConditionTree`, engine.go:42), then `render.go` walks that tree and emits dialect-specific SQL fragments/casts per branch (`DialectSQLite`/`DialectPostgres`/`DialectMySQL` switch cases throughout internal/filter/render.go, e.g. lines 231-238, 365-402, 452-508), producing a SQL string plus args (`CompileToStatement`, engine.go:73) that `ListMemos` appends to `memoFind.Filters` (server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:211-223).

**q26.** `memo` (the row itself), `memo_relation` (both as source and target), `attachment` (linked attachments deleted), and comment memos (recursively also memo/memo_relation/attachment rows) — from store/memo.go:140-158 and server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:567-580. `memo_share` has an `ON DELETE CASCADE` foreign key to memo at the DB level (store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:109), so it is also affected implicitly.

**q27.** Mechanism: the built React app is embedded into the Go binary via `//go:embed dist/*` and served by an Echo-based static file service. Wired in server/router/frontend/frontend.go:20-21 (embed) and invoked from server/server.go:72 (`frontend.NewFrontendService(profile, store).Serve(ctx, echoServer)`).

**q28.** Only one background runner is actually started: `s3presign.Runner` (server/runner/s3presign/runner.go), started in server/server.go:162-171 — an initial `RunOnce` then a goroutine looping on a 12-hour `time.Ticker` (runnerInterval, s3presign/runner.go:27-41). Unused-infra note: `internal/scheduler` package (a full cron-style scheduler, internal/scheduler/scheduler.go) exists but is referenced only from its own README/doc/tests — grep across the codebase shows no non-test caller — so it is present but not used by the running server. (`server/runner/memopayload`'s `RebuildMemoPayload` is not a background runner either; it's called synchronously inside `CreateMemo`/`UpdateMemo` handlers, not scheduled.)

**q29.** Interceptor: `authInterceptor` in web/src/connect.ts:156 (wired into the Connect transport at connect.ts:184-189).
